title: Claude 4 Opus deep thinking token count broken
body:
### 📦 Platform

Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

server db(lobe-chat-database image)

### 📌 Version

1.88.0

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Other

### 🐛 Bug Description

When trying to use the deep thinking option with Claude 4 Opus, it errors even with tiny requests

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ebeff551-d07b-4518-a440-875a304db8d2)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e8d863a-bd1b-43b7-a011-8ef421597987)

The error text:

```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "max_tokens: 64000 > 32000, which is the maximum allowed number of output tokens for claude-opus-4-20250514"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.anthropic.com",
  "provider": "anthropic"
}
```

This is a single word message with a 1k token limit set for thinking and it fails. However, if I toggle off extended thinking, it works and even huge input requests work. 

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Start a new chat with Claude 4 Opus and set "enable deep thinking" to "on". 

Now, send any message. 

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

I expect this to function like Claude 4 Sonnet does, in which it returns a response with "thinking" tags. 

I believe Opus has a maximum output of 32,000 tokens whereas Sonnet has a maximum output of 64,000. So you may just need to update this in the request. 

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves an LLM provider (Claude 4 Opus) and reports a problem with token usage misconfiguration, specifically exceeding the maximum allowed output tokens for the model, which is a component unique to LLM-based agent systems.
